title: Composing with a Keyhole View
content: Here's a new aYouTube videobased on a gouache painting I did in the old boatyard in Greenport, Long Island.A little glimpse of the harbor and the far shore is framed by the boat and the buildings. I call this composition a "keyhole view."Artists in the past have used keyhole views to lure the viewer's attention back in space.This painting inside the farrier's shop has a keyhole view on the doorway at the left. It's byFerdinand Georg Waldmüller(Austrian, 1793-1865).Lawrence Alma Tadema(Dutch, 1836-1912) uses a similar compositional strategy.And there's a keyhole view in this painting byIlya Repin(Russian, 1844-1930).
